notes.title: Version 1.3.1
notes.notes:
- Small changes made in world 2

- The bouncing force when the player is on the edge of a platform is a little stronger

- The sensitivity option for the mouse / joystick(controller) is slightly improved 

- Some towers in the sci-fi world(5) are updated visually

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
• Improved Visual Quality
- Better graphics.

• Improved Mechanics
- Better movement mechanics.
- If you now get stuck on the edge of a platform or other object you get bounced up.

• New Stamina System
- The game now haves a stamina bar for the sprinting.

• New Achievement
- New achievement in the time trial mode

• Fixed Some Small Bugs

notes.title: Version 1.0 | Release date & more information
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=648zfLI2l5Y;full][/previewyoutube]
Aerial Platforms is first person platformer, where you complete levels under certain time, using agility and skills to jump on different objects while "the floor is lava" type of game.

The game contains a campaign with total of 50 levels (5 worlds)
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/7800d55f0e952cb776ffbb521f56f78f990e2a25.png
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/5f4ddd305ef6a327aa7af3d4283ecbbf82d6e12f.png
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/c6d8bf039a39303f77bab490a229f206dbc35bdc.png
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/db1785fcd1bd43de57c85c57bbcba449c2c98d72.png
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/5fa4277aa48e7ce332746a1f41577537d22994ba.png
Each world gets more and more complex and challenging.
As you go through different worlds you will unlock new ability skills like an air dash and double jump as the levels will get more insane with all kind of obstacles to dodge.

A separate mode with time trial levels with high-score system
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/273a9becff95c3f79dc42c71fed73cdd1d5f6068.png
The time trial mode contains levels with high-score system (best time to beat the level)
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/691ee11d2040f337727e6cd5c8d8dc8e9d19aa54.png
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43009055/566bcb60d6e844d8b6f2bf9799ba67374135a36e.png

* ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

■ First when you open the campaign you will have total of 50 levels to complete the game. Total of 5 worlds.

■ At the beginning there are no unlocked abilities. The first ability skill is unlocked from level 11.

■ The time trial mode is open to play, but you won't have skills, unless you have unlocked them in the campaign.

The game is available for Windows and Linux
